app_release_notes: v1.17.4 - Adding your chronograph or target data to a load you already started no longer asks if it's a new test. The DOPE card shows energy in joules when your speeds are in meters per second. Plainer wording in the Results winner notes. Starting a different kind of test on a load now offers a clean new load. Plus fixes and improvements.

windows.app_release_notes: v1.17.3 - A different test now always gets its own load. Importing new charges into a load that already has speeds can no longer mix two tests together. Compare Loads shows each load's name and length, so loads with the same powder and charge are easy to tell apart. Plus fixes and improvements.
